original.statement: LogCLI no longer takes the remote schema store from -boltdb.shipper.shared-store when -remote-schema is true; the new -schema-store flag replaces it.

decision.reason: [ev-eec682284370] says LogCLI used to take the store for fetching the remote schema from `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store`. It also says a new CLI flag, `-schema-store`, "is introduced as a replacement" to configure that store. That fits a cli-flag rename for the logcli component, with replacedBy `-schema-store`, and the flag names are spelled exactly as the evidence gives them. The validators were inconclusive because the Helm render failed, so they neither confirm nor contradict this.
